models3d.title: Cassini–Huygens
models3d.what: High-gain dish, RTG booms, and the Huygens probe — Saturn orbiter.

models3d.title: Voyager
models3d.what: 3.7 m dish, magnetometer boom, and RTG truss — the Grand Tour bus.

models3d.title: Galileo
models3d.what: Dual-spin bus with the furled high-gain umbrella antenna.

models3d.title: New Horizons
models3d.what: Compact triangular bus with a single dish — the Pluto flyby probe.

models3d.title: Pioneer
models3d.what: Spin-stabilised dish, RTG booms, and the engraved plaque.

models3d.title: Juno
models3d.what: Three vast solar wings around a hexagonal bus — Jupiter polar orbiter.

models3d.title: BepiColombo
models3d.what: Stacked transfer module + Mercury orbiters with ion thrusters.

models3d.title: Dawn
models3d.what: Ion-drive bus with wide solar wings — Vesta + Ceres orbiter.

models3d.title: Giotto
models3d.what: Drum-shaped spinner with a dust shield — Halley’s Comet flyby.

models3d.title: Hayabusa2
models3d.what: Boxy bus with solar panels and sampler horn — asteroid Ryugu.

models3d.title: JUICE
models3d.what: Cross-shaped solar arrays on a compact bus — Jupiter icy-moons orbiter.

models3d.title: Rosetta
models3d.what: 14 m solar wings around a comet-chasing bus + Philae lander.

models3d.title: Ulysses
models3d.what: RTG-powered solar polar probe with a single dish.

models3d.title: Vega
models3d.what: Soviet Venus flyby + balloon mother-craft with a steerable dish.

models3d.title: Venera 13
models3d.what: Soviet Venus lander — toroidal aerobrake and landing ring.

models3d.title: Generic launcher
models3d.what: Falcon-9-like two-stage body — the agency-keyed fallback silhouette.

models3d.title: Saturn V
models3d.what: Tapered three-stage stack, five F-1 bells, roll-pattern livery, and the escape tower.

models3d.title: Saturn IB
models3d.what: The Apollo LEO workhorse — a clustered S-IB first stage of eight H-1 engines under the same S-IVB + CSM.

models3d.title: Soyuz / R-7
models3d.what: Korolev-cross core with four tapered strap-on boosters.

models3d.title: Ariane 5
models3d.what: Cryogenic core between two tall solid boosters under a bulbous fairing.

models3d.title: H-IIA
models3d.what: Japanese cryogenic core with paired solid rocket boosters.

models3d.title: Space Shuttle
models3d.what: External tank, twin SRBs, and the delta-wing orbiter.

models3d.title: Falcon 9
models3d.what: Slender two-stage body — an octaweb of nine engines, grid fins, and landing legs.

models3d.title: Starship / Super Heavy
models3d.what: Bare-stainless fully-reusable stack — 33 Raptors on Super Heavy, 6 on Starship, forward + aft flaps, and the ogive nose.

models3d.title: Atlas V
models3d.what: Wide RD-180 core with a bulbous payload fairing and optional solid strap-ons.

models3d.title: Proton-K
models3d.what: Soviet heavy — a central core ringed by six outboard fuel tanks.

models3d.title: Titan II GLV
models3d.what: Slender uniform two-stage that launched the crewed Gemini capsules.

models3d.title: Atlas LV-3B
models3d.what: Mercury-Atlas stage-and-a-half with a booster-engine skirt and escape tower.

models3d.title: Mercury-Redstone
models3d.what: America’s first crewed launcher — a slim single-engine Redstone with four tail fins, the Mercury capsule and escape tower (Freedom 7).

models3d.title: Long March 2F
models3d.what: China’s crewed launcher — core, four liquid strap-ons, and a launch-escape tower (Shenzhou).

models3d.title: Long March 3B
models3d.what: Chinese GTO workhorse — a core with four liquid strap-ons (Chang’e lunar missions).

models3d.title: Long March 5
models3d.what: China’s heavy “Fat Five” — a wide cryogenic core with four large boosters.

models3d.title: PSLV
models3d.what: ISRO’s workhorse — a slender core ringed by six solid strap-on boosters.

models3d.title: LVM3 / GSLV Mk III
models3d.what: ISRO heavy-lift — a core flanked by two large S200 solid boosters (Chandrayaan-3).

models3d.title: M-V
models3d.what: JAXA’s all-solid three-stage launcher (Hayabusa).

models3d.title: H3
models3d.what: JAXA’s new cryogenic core with solid strap-on boosters.

models3d.title: Ariane 1
models3d.what: Europe’s first launcher — a slender three-stage 1979 design (Giotto).

models3d.title: Long March 3A
models3d.what: Core and second stage hot-staged over an open truss under a cryogenic third stage and a 3.35 m fairing, no strap-ons (Chang’e 1).

models3d.title: Long March 7
models3d.what: CALT’s 3.35 m kerosene rocket for the Tianzhou freighters — a core, a second stage and four 2.25 m strap-on boosters.

models3d.title: Delta II
models3d.what: Turquoise Thor-derived first stage ringed by nine white solid boosters, under a boat-tailed 2.9 m fairing.

models3d.title: Atlas-Centaur
models3d.what: Steel-balloon Atlas stage-and-a-half under the white Centaur upper stage and nose fairing (Mariner 9 and 10, Pioneer 10 and 11).

models3d.title: Atlas-Agena
models3d.what: The same Atlas under a slim Agena D upper stage and a small shroud (Mariner 4).

models3d.title: Titan II(23)G
models3d.what: Two Titan core stages under a payload fairing (Clementine).

models3d.title: Titan IIIE-Centaur
models3d.what: Titan core with two five-segment solid boosters, an interstage and the Centaur inside its shroud (Viking, Voyager).

models3d.title: Titan IVB-Centaur
models3d.what: Titan core with two long solid motors under a 20 m fairing that encloses the Centaur (Cassini).

models3d.title: Falcon Heavy
models3d.what: Three Falcon 9 cores side by side — side boosters with nose cones, grid fins and legs, and a centre core carrying the upper stage and fairing.

models3d.title: Athena II
models3d.what: All-solid stack — two Castor 120 stages, a third stage and a tapered fairing (Lunar Prospector).

models3d.title: Delta IV Heavy
models3d.what: Three common booster cores abreast, the centre one carrying the cryogenic upper stage and a 19 m fairing (Parker Solar Probe).

models3d.title: New Glenn
models3d.what: A single 7 m stick — a seven-engine first stage with legs and strakes under a 7 m ogive fairing (Blue Moon MK1).

models3d.title: Proton-M / Briz-M
models3d.what: Central core ringed by six outboard fuel tanks, two more stages and a Briz-M upper stage under a 4.35 m fairing.

models3d.title: SLS Block 1
models3d.what: Orange foam core stage on four RS-25s, two white five-segment boosters, the stage adapter and upper stage under Orion and its abort tower (Artemis).

models3d.title: Molniya-M
models3d.what: Four-stage R-7 — the Blok I on its lattice, the Blok L escape stage and the probe under a cylinder-and-cone shroud (Luna 9, Luna 10).

models3d.title: Soyuz-FG / Fregat
models3d.what: The R-7 and its upper stage topped by the squat Fregat and the probe under a wider shroud (Mars Express).

models3d.title: Sputnik 8K71PS
models3d.what: The two-stage R-7 that launched Sputnik 1 — no third stage, the satellite riding under the core’s nose cone.

models3d.title: Soyuz-2
models3d.what: The modernised 46.3 m R-7 — four boosters round the core, an upper stage on an open truss and a long fairing.

models3d.title: Antares 230+
models3d.what: Northrop Grumman’s Cygnus launcher — a 3.9 m kerosene first stage on two RD-181s under a solid second stage and fairing.

models3d.title: Ariane 6
models3d.what: Europe’s 5.4 m cryogenic core and Vinci upper stage under a 20 m fairing, with four solid boosters (A64).

models3d.title: Vulcan Centaur
models3d.what: ULA’s 5.4 m methane first stage on two BE-4s, the Centaur V and a 5.4 m fairing, with GEM 63XL solid boosters.

models3d.title: Energia–Buran
models3d.what: The 7.75 m hydrogen core with four RD-170 strap-ons and the Buran orbiter riding on its flank.

models3d.title: N1
models3d.what: The Soviet Moon rocket — five stages in a cone, thirty engines on the first, under the L3 shroud and escape tower.

models3d.title: Soyuz 7K-OK
models3d.what: The first-generation Soyuz at 7.95 m — orbital, descent and service modules, 9.8 m solar wings and the Igla rendezvous antennas.

models3d.title: Soyuz T / TM / TMA / MS (4 variants)
models3d.what: The 7.48 m Soyuz across four generations — Igla antennas on the T, Kurs on the TM and TMA, Kurs-NA and a micrometeoroid shield on the MS.

models3d.title: Crew Dragon
models3d.what: The 8.1 m capsule-and-trunk stack with its windows, SuperDraco pods and solar-cell trunk.

models3d.title: Starliner (CST-100)
models3d.what: Boeing’s 5.03 m capsule and service module — the blue band and the thruster pods.

models3d.title: Gaganyaan
models3d.what: ISRO’s 5.58 m crew module on its service module, with deployable solar wings.

models3d.title: Orion
models3d.what: The 7.9 m Artemis crew module and European service module with its solar arrays.

models3d.title: New Shepard
models3d.what: The 19.2 m suborbital vehicle — a 3.8 m booster under the crew capsule with its large windows.

models3d.title: Apollo CSM Block I / II (2 variants)
models3d.what: The command and service module at 10.6 and 11 m — the conical command module on the cylindrical service module and its engine bell.

models3d.title: Shenzhou
models3d.what: China’s 9.25 m three-module craft in the Soyuz lineage — orbital module, re-entry module and service module with its solar wings.

models3d.title: Space Shuttle orbiter
models3d.what: One 37.2 m orbiter drawn once for the four sisters — Atlantis, Challenger, Discovery and Endeavour — lying on the runway.

models3d.title: Space Shuttle Columbia
models3d.what: The first orbiter — the only one with black chines, and the instrument pod on its tail fin.

models3d.title: Space Shuttle Enterprise
models3d.what: The atmospheric test orbiter — no main engines, no OMS pods, simulated tiles.

models3d.title: Buran
models3d.what: The Soviet orbiter at 36.4 m — a 24 m double-delta wing, its main engines left on the Energia core.

models3d.title: Buran OK-GLI
models3d.what: The atmospheric test vehicle with Buran’s shape and mass — four AL-31 turbofans at the tail.

models3d.title: X-37B
models3d.what: The U.S. Space Force’s 8.92 m uncrewed spaceplane with its 4.55 m wingspan.

models3d.title: Progress 7K-TG / M / MS (3 variants)
models3d.what: The Soyuz-derived cargo ship from 7.23 to 7.94 m — service module, refuelling section and cargo module, the 7K-TG without solar wings.

models3d.title: Cargo Dragon 2
models3d.what: The windowless uncrewed Dragon 2 on its 8.1 m trunk — the ISS cargo ship.

models3d.title: Dragon 1
models3d.what: The original 6.1 m cargo Dragon — a 3.7 m capsule on its trunk with two solar arrays.

models3d.title: Cygnus Standard / Enhanced (2 variants)
models3d.what: Northrop Grumman’s station freighter at 5.14 and 6.39 m — a pressurised cargo module over the service module with round solar arrays.

models3d.title: HTV (Kounotori)
models3d.what: Japan’s 9.8 m station freighter — a pressurised module and an open pallet on the service section.

models3d.title: HTV-X
models3d.what: Japan’s 8 m successor freighter — a pressurised cargo module over the service module with its solar wings.

models3d.title: ATV
models3d.what: ESA’s 10.3 m Automated Transfer Vehicle — a cylindrical cargo carrier with four X-shaped solar wings.

models3d.title: Tianzhou
models3d.what: China’s 10.6 m cargo ship — a long cargo module over the service module and its solar wings.

models3d.title: Launcher line-up
models3d.what: Every rocket with a model, from Starship to Mercury-Redstone, stood side by side at its real height beside a 1.75 m person.

models3d.title: Landmarks at true height
models3d.what: Sixteen landmarks and icons hand-drawn at their sourced heights — from the Eiffel Tower and the Statue of Liberty to Michelangelo’s David, a London Routemaster and a VW Beetle.

models3d.title: Capsule and spacecraft line-up
models3d.what: Capsules, freighters and orbiters at true size — the orbiters lying on the runway, the capsules standing as on their rockets.

models3d.title: Cartoon cast
models3d.what: A flat-coloured cast at true size — man, woman, child, dog, cat, Terracotta warrior, giant panda, brown bear, giraffe and elephant — standing between the craft.

models3d.title: Parker Solar Probe
models3d.what: The 3 m Sun-grazer — a 2.3 m carbon-composite heat shield over a slim bus, with two small cooled solar arrays.

models3d.title: Solar Orbiter
models3d.what: ESA’s 3.1 m Sun-watcher — a heat shield on the Sun side, six solar panels spanning 18 m and a 4.4 m instrument boom.

models3d.title: MESSENGER
models3d.what: The Mercury orbiter behind its 2.5 m ceramic-cloth sunshade, with two solar arrays and a 3.6 m magnetometer boom.

models3d.title: Magellan
models3d.what: The Venus radar mapper at 6.4 m — a ten-sided bus, the Star 48B motor and a 3.7 m high-gain dish.

models3d.title: Akatsuki
models3d.what: JAXA’s 1.45 m box-shaped Venus orbiter with two solar arrays and a flat phased-array antenna.

models3d.title: DART
models3d.what: The 2.6 m asteroid-impact spacecraft with two 8.5 m solar arrays, the NEXT-C ion engine and the DRACO camera.

models3d.title: Lucy
models3d.what: The Trojan-asteroid explorer, 16 m tip to tip — two circular solar arrays about 7 m across and a 2 m high-gain dish.

models3d.title: Psyche
models3d.what: The metal-asteroid orbiter — a 7.3 m craft with 25 m of deployed solar arrays and 2 m instrument booms.

models3d.title: Europa Clipper
models3d.what: The 5 m Jupiter-moon orbiter with 30.5 m solar arrays, a 3.1 m high-gain antenna and an 8.5 m magnetometer boom.

models3d.title: Mars Express
models3d.what: ESA’s 1.8 m box bus with two 2.5 m solar wings (about 12 m tip to tip) and a 1.6 m high-gain dish.

models3d.title: MAVEN
models3d.what: NASA’s 3.47 m Mars-atmosphere orbiter — a 2.3 m cubic bus, two gull-winged arrays with magnetometers at their tips and a 2 m dish.

models3d.title: Mangalyaan
models3d.what: ISRO’s Mars Orbiter Mission — a 1.5 m gold-wrapped cube with a three-panel array and a 2.2 m reflector.

models3d.title: Hope
models3d.what: The UAE’s Emirates Mars Mission orbiter — a 2.9 m hexagonal bus with two solar wings and a 1.85 m dish.

models3d.title: Mariner 4, 9 and 10 (3 variants)
models3d.what: NASA’s octagonal Mariner family — four solar panels with tip vanes on Mariner 4 and 9; two panels, a sunshade and a 5.8 m magnetometer boom on Mariner 10.

models3d.title: Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter
models3d.what: NASA’s 3.9 m Moon mapper — a box bus with a single 10.7 m² solar array and a steerable dish.

models3d.title: Skylab
models3d.what: America’s first space station — the Orbital Workshop, airlock and docking adapter, the solar-telescope mount with its windmill of panels, and the sunshade.

models3d.title: Clementine, SMART-1, Chang’e 1 and Chandrayaan-1 (4 variants)
models3d.what: One box-bus builder in four sizes — Clementine’s 1.9 m bus, the 1 m SMART-1 cube, Chang’e 1 and a gold-wrapped Chandrayaan-1 — each with its own solar wings and dish.

models3d.title: Lunar Prospector
models3d.what: The 1.36 m drum covered in solar cells, with three 2.5 m instrument booms.

models3d.title: Luna 10
models3d.what: The Soviet 1.5 m pressurised cylinder with four antenna whips and a boom — the first craft to orbit the Moon.

models3d.title: Sputnik 1
models3d.what: The polished 58 cm sphere with its hemisphere seam, 36 bolts and four swept-back whip antennas of 2.4 and 2.9 m.

models3d.title: Apollo Lunar Module
models3d.what: Descent + ascent stage, gold MLI foil, and RCS quads.

models3d.title: Apollo LM (J-mission + LRV)
models3d.what: Extended-stay LM paired with the Lunar Roving Vehicle.

models3d.title: Luna 9
models3d.what: Soviet sphere that returned the first images from the lunar surface.

models3d.title: Luna sample-return
models3d.what: Ascent rocket atop a descent platform (Luna 16 / 20 / 24).

models3d.title: Lunokhod rover
models3d.what: Eight-wheeled Soviet rover with a clamshell solar lid.

models3d.title: Chang’e lander
models3d.what: CNSA descent stage with ascent capsule (Chang’e 5 / 6).

models3d.title: Yutu rover
models3d.what: Six-wheeled Chinese rover with folding solar panels.

models3d.title: Chandrayaan-3 Vikram
models3d.what: ISRO four-leg lander that delivered the Pragyan rover.

models3d.title: SLIM
models3d.what: JAXA precision “Moon Sniper” two-engine descent stage.

models3d.title: Beresheet
models3d.what: SpaceIL’s compact four-leg lander.

models3d.title: Viking
models3d.what: Tripod-legged NASA lander with RTG and sampling arm.

models3d.title: Pathfinder + Sojourner
models3d.what: Tetrahedral airbag lander and the first Mars rover.

models3d.title: MER (Spirit / Opportunity)
models3d.what: Rocker-bogie rover with butterfly solar wings.

models3d.title: Curiosity
models3d.what: MSL-class RTG rover with mast + arm.

models3d.title: Perseverance + Ingenuity
models3d.what: Mars 2020 rover with Mastcam-Z mast, sample-caching bay, and the Ingenuity helicopter.

models3d.title: Phoenix
models3d.what: Solar stationary lander with a robotic arm.

models3d.title: InSight
models3d.what: Decagonal solar-panelled geophysics lander with the SEIS seismometer and HP3 mole.

models3d.title: Mars 3
models3d.what: Soviet petal lander — first soft Mars touchdown.

models3d.title: Tianwen-1 Zhurong
models3d.what: Chinese rover with butterfly arrays and a mast.

models3d.title: Schiaparelli
models3d.what: ESA entry-descent-landing demonstrator capsule.

models3d.title: Beagle 2
models3d.what: Clamshell ESA lander with petal solar panels.

models3d.title: Venera / Vega lander
models3d.what: Soviet Venus surface lander — a pressure sphere on a toroidal crush-ring.

models3d.title: Lunar powered descent
models3d.what: Vacuum retro-descent stage — no aeroshell or parachute (Apollo / Chang’e / Luna).

models3d.title: Mars parachute + retro
models3d.what: Aeroshell, supersonic parachute, and terminal retro-rockets (Viking / Phoenix / InSight).

models3d.title: Mars airbag bounce
models3d.what: Tetrahedral airbag cocoon that bounces to rest (Pathfinder / Spirit / Opportunity).

models3d.title: Mars skycrane
models3d.what: Rocket-powered descent stage that lowers the rover on tethers (Curiosity / Perseverance).

models3d.title: Venus aeroshell
models3d.what: Sphere-cone entry capsule and braking disk for the dense atmosphere (Venera / Vega).

models3d.title: Asteroid touch-and-go
models3d.what: Sampler bus with a collection horn — micro-gravity touch-and-go (Hayabusa / OSIRIS-REx).

models3d.title: Comet harpoon lander
models3d.what: Three-leg micro-gravity lander with anchoring harpoons (Philae at comet 67P).

models3d.title: Jupiter atmospheric probe
models3d.what: Sphere-cone aeroshell and parachute for a deep-atmosphere entry (Galileo probe).

models3d.title: Titan parachute descent
models3d.what: Aeroshell and large parachute for a slow descent through Titan’s haze (Huygens).

models3d.title: Curiosity cruise stage
models3d.what: MSL cruise-stage disk over the aeroshell enclosing the rover.

models3d.title: Perseverance cruise stage
models3d.what: Mars 2020 cruise stage + aeroshell (rover + Ingenuity sealed inside).

models3d.title: InSight cruise stage
models3d.what: Cruise-stage disk over the aeroshell carrying the lander.

models3d.title: Phoenix cruise stage
models3d.what: Cruise stage + aeroshell for the polar lander.

models3d.title: Pathfinder cruise stage
models3d.what: Cruise stage + aeroshell (airbag lander + Sojourner inside).

models3d.title: Spirit cruise stage
models3d.what: MER cruise stage + aeroshell.

models3d.title: Opportunity cruise stage
models3d.what: MER cruise stage + aeroshell.

models3d.title: Schiaparelli + TGO
models3d.what: ExoMars Trace Gas Orbiter carrying the Schiaparelli entry capsule.

models3d.title: Viking orbiter + lander
models3d.what: Viking orbiter with the bioshield-capsule lander below.

models3d.title: Mars 3 bus
models3d.what: Soviet M-71 bus with the descent capsule and solar wings.

models3d.title: Tianwen-1 orbiter
models3d.what: Orbiter bus carrying the entry capsule (Zhurong inside).

models3d.title: Apollo CSM + LM
models3d.what: Command/Service Module docked to the Lunar Module — the trans-lunar stack (Apollo 11–17).

models3d.title: Orion (Artemis)
models3d.what: Orion crew capsule + European Service Module with four solar wings (Artemis IV / V).

models3d.title: Luna 9 direct-ascent
models3d.what: Soviet direct bus with the spherical lander capsule on top.

models3d.title: Luna sample-return
models3d.what: Descent stage with spherical tanks, ascent stage, and return capsule (Luna 16 / 24).

models3d.title: Lunokhod carrier
models3d.what: Descent-stage bus carrying the Lunokhod rover (Luna 17 / 21).

models3d.title: Chang’e 3 / 4
models3d.what: CNSA lander descent stage with the Yutu rover stowed on top.

models3d.title: Chang’e 5 / 6
models3d.what: Four-module sample-return stack — orbiter, returner, ascender, and lander.

models3d.title: Chandrayaan-3
models3d.what: ISRO propulsion module carrying the Vikram lander.

models3d.title: SLIM
models3d.what: JAXA’s compact “Moon Sniper” cruise bus.

models3d.title: Beresheet
models3d.what: SpaceIL’s small round four-leg lander in transit.

models3d.title: Blue Moon MK1
models3d.what: Blue Origin’s tall lander — central tank on a four-leg frame.

models3d.title: Hayabusa cruise
models3d.what: JAXA sample-return bus — solar wings, a sampler horn, and ion engines.

models3d.title: OSIRIS-REx cruise
models3d.what: Boxy bus with V-angled solar wings and the extended TAGSAM sampler arm.

models3d.title: NEAR Shoemaker
models3d.what: Orbiter bus with four fixed solar panels in a cross and a fixed dish.

models3d.title: Starship
models3d.what: Stainless upper stage — nose cone, fore/aft flaps, and a Raptor cluster (Mars transit).

models3d.title: Hubble
models3d.what: Cylindrical observatory with aperture door and solar wings.

models3d.title: JWST
models3d.what: Tennis-court sunshield beneath a segmented gold mirror.

models3d.title: Chandra
models3d.what: Elongated X-ray observatory with solar wings.

models3d.title: XMM-Newton
models3d.what: Long ESA X-ray telescope tube.

models3d.title: Gaia
models3d.what: Sunshade-skirted ESA astrometry observatory.

models3d.title: LRO
models3d.what: Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter bus and dish.

models3d.title: GEO comsat
models3d.what: Box bus with deployed solar wings and antennas.

models3d.title: Navigation constellation
models3d.what: GPS-class satellite cluster (GPS / Galileo / GLONASS / BeiDou).

models3d.title: Generic orbiter bus
models3d.what: Hex bus + solar wings + antenna, agency-keyed fallback build.

models3d.title: Launch facility
models3d.what: Octagonal pad with four lightning towers — Kennedy, Baikonur, Jiuquan, and others.

models3d.title: ISS proxy model
models3d.what: Full truss, pressurised modules, docked visitors, and steerable arrays.

models3d.title: Tiangong proxy model
models3d.what: T-configuration core + lab modules, docked Shenzhou / Tianzhou, and arrays.

models3d.title: Microgravity axes
models3d.what: Six labelled arrows marking the station local frame (zenith/nadir…).

models3d.title: Orbiter rings + marker halos
models3d.what: Inclination-tilted altitude rings and selection glow halos.

models3d.title: Iconic mission trajectories
models3d.what: Voyager, Pioneer, New Horizons, Cassini, Juno, Dawn flight paths.

capsules.title: Mercury capsule
capsules.what: Blunt ablative heat shield, shingled cone, and the recovery + antenna section (Freedom 7 … Faith 7).

capsules.title: Gemini capsule
capsules.what: Two-seat scaled-up Mercury with the rendezvous-radar nose and adapter module.

capsules.title: Vostok
capsules.what: The spherical Sharik descent module — antenna straps and equipment collar; the cosmonaut ejected and parachuted down separately.

capsules.title: Voskhod
capsules.what: The same Sharik sphere, now carrying the solid-propellant soft-landing retro package on a strut truss — the crew rode it to the ground.

capsules.title: Apollo Command Module
capsules.what: The classic steep blunt cone with the forward docking tunnel (Apollo 7/9, Skylab, ASTP).

capsules.title: Soyuz descent module
capsules.what: The "headlamp" bell — spherical base heat shield with a conical crew top.

capsules.title: Crew Dragon
capsules.what: Sleek conical body with the SuperDraco pods and the PICA-X heat shield (Inspiration4, Polaris Dawn).

capsules.title: Shenzhou reentry module
capsules.what: A broad Soyuz-lineage bell — its own lighter-silver hull with a grey equipment band (Shenzhou-1 onward).

canvas2d.title: Landing-page hero
canvas2d.what: Flat-family orrery poster — glowing sun, tilted orbit rings, and one highlighted cyan transfer arc.

canvas2d.title: 2D system map
canvas2d.what: Top-down orrery with shaded planets, glow, orbit rings, and Saturn’s rings.

canvas2d.title: Porkchop Δv heatmap
canvas2d.what: Departure × time-of-flight grid colour-mapped from a Lambert solver.

canvas2d.title: Station blueprints
canvas2d.what: Orthographic top / side projections of every station module.

canvas2d.title: Surface-map nation legend

writing.title: Science encyclopedia
writing.what: 117 original explainers across orbital mechanics, propulsion, life in space, Earth-from-space, and spaceflight history — plus every figure caption.

writing.title: World profiles
writing.what: Descriptive copy for the 9 planets and 22 small bodies — comets, asteroids, and Kuiper-belt objects — shown on the orrery.

writing.title: Station module notes
writing.what: Operational and historical notes for all 22 ISS and Tiangong modules, written for the blueprint panels.

writing.title: Surface + panorama captions
writing.what: Hotspot labels and annotated panorama captions that name what you’re looking at on each Moon and Mars scene.

writing.title: Audio tour scripts
writing.what: Every guided + extended tour episode is originally written for Orrery; only the text-to-speech voices are third-party (credited on the Credits page).

writing.title: Physics Lab formula registry
writing.what: The Physics Lab is built on 64 original formula definitions — each with its equation, parameter ranges, fail-honest reasoning, stated assumptions, and computed-figure spec — authored in-house over real physics. The reference constants they compute from (JPL/IAU/EGM96) are cited on the Credits page.

writing.title: Physics Lab goals
writing.what: 25 original learning-goal ladders that chain the formulas into narrated journeys — from launching a rocket to touching a comet — with a written practical-connection panel for each.

writing.title: Physics Lab interface, in 14 languages
writing.what: Every Lab string — formula titles, parameter labels, assumptions, narration, error states — is originally authored and machine-translated across all 14 supported locales.
